feeds.title: Arabian Horse Exchange Blog
feeds.description: Get all the Arabian Horse Exchange featured news, notes, and a variety of share-worthy articles. We link sellers with buyers and buyers with the Arabian Horse. Our mission is to be the primary online Arabian horse marketing and sales provider of choice by connecting buyers to sellers and promoting the Arabian breed by actively recruiting newcomers to the industry.

feeds.title: The Arabian Magazine
feeds.description: The Arabian Magazine & The Arabian Breeders' Magazine is an award-winning publication that was founded in 2004 and since then they have been celebrating the true heart and soul of the Arabian horse! The Magazine satisfies the immediate need for results, reports, and photographs from the shows in real-time. In addition, news and other items are also shared that give all information about the events that occur.

feeds.title: all for the love of a horse...
feeds.description: Get the information about various Arabian horses and much more in our blog space, and become a part of the family that cherishes the stallion world with all their hearts!We present to u all the stories about our various beloved Arabian horses. Each issue beautifully celebrates the many reasons why we are perpetually enchanted with this breed of horse!

feeds.title: Daughters of the Wind
feeds.description: Daughters of the Wind is a blog that is entirely based on desert arabian horses. This blog space presents my views on various topics as well as my travel experiences.

feeds.title: Arabian Horse Travel
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Janet, and welcome to my blog, Arabian Horse Travel. I blog about my journey as horse breeders & adult amateurs in the Arabian horse world--where I stay, what I eat & drink, who I ride, and how I compete. I'm blessed to live this lifestyle & I'm glad you're along for the ride!

feeds.title: Arabian Horse Life
feeds.description: The Arabian Horse Connection Blog is about Arabian horses and the people who love them, a free resource for all Arabian horse lovers. The blog covers stories, the latest trends, industry news, and all the Arabian horses! The AHC Blog pairs with the Arabian Horse Connection Podcast. Listen in and be a part of the connection!
